description: tests/test_claude_code.py pins the 'tether init claude-code' installer in tether/claude_code/install.py: which files it writes (the .tether/tether.md fragment, the tether-onboard SKILL.md, the CLAUDE.md @import line, .claude/settings.json permissions, .claude/settings.local.json hooks, the .gitignore entry), idempotence, and unconditional overwrite of tether-owned content. Changes to what install() writes or its idempotence must be reflected in these tests.
